title: Values Produced by an Input Buffer
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers, let each of $m$ source positions select either one of $n$ Boolean inputs or a Boolean constant, and let $x$ be an assignment of Boolean values to those $n$ inputs. Form the list of gates that copies the selected input or produces the selected constant, and run these gates in order starting with the list of the $n$ input values, evaluating each gate from the values already present. For every buffer position $i$, the value at index $n+i$ of the resulting list, using false as the default if out of range, equals the value selected by source position $i$.
hypotheses_covered: A source selector maps each of $m$ positions to one of $n$ inputs or a Boolean constant
$x$ assigns a Boolean value to each of the $n$ inputs
